data.title: Yanbu Welcomes Visitors During the Autumn Holiday
data.content:
Yanbu, November 22, 2026 SPA -- Yanbu Governorate is preparing to welcome visitors from across the Kingdom during the autumn holiday, offering pleasant weather and a diverse range of attractions that make it an ideal destination for families and those seeking tourism and entertainment.
    During the holiday, the governorate will host cultural and entertainment events, along with activities that offer visitors a wide range of options and enrich their tourism experiences. Yanbu is also distinguished by its waterfronts, tourist attractions, and heritage sites, where visitors can enjoy recreational activities, explore the governorate's landmarks, and discover its rich cultural heritage.
    These attractions and events give visitors the opportunity to enjoy the diverse tourism experiences offered by the governorate, further strengthening Yanbu's position as a tourist destination that attracts families and visitors during the autumn holiday.
    -- SPA
